registers.name: GICR_WAKER
registers.description: Redistributor Wake Register。GIC Redistributor (GICR) 寄存器

fields.name: ChildrenAsleep
fields.description: Read-only. 指示是否 the connected PE is quiescent: [0b0=An interface to the connected PE might be active. ; 0b1=All interfaces to the connected PE are quiescent.]

fields.name: ProcessorSleep
fields.description: 指示是否 the Redistributor can assert the WakeRequest signal: Before powering down a PE, 软件 must set this bit to 1 and wait until ChildrenAsleep == 1. After powering up a PE, or following a failed powerdown, 软件 must set this bit to 0 and wait until ChildrenAsleep == 0. Changing ProcessorSleep from 1 to 0 when ChildrenAsleep is not 1 results in UNPREDICTABLE behavior. Changing ProcessorSleep from 0 to 1 when the Enable for each interrupt group in the associated CPU interface is not 0 results in UNPREDICTABLE behavior. [0b0=This PE is not in, and is not entering, a low power state. ; 0b1=The PE is either in, or is in the process of entering, a low]
